_comment: The Watch barracks (14x8), reached via barracks_door on the street (22,3 -- the former watch_guard flavor NPC's spot, now a real door; the Watch post facade decor at (22,1)/(22,2) already implied a doorway here). Duty Sergeant Dresk Ashgrave (profile in docs/design/character-profiles.md) is that RELOCATED watch_guard, given a name/voice/tint -- zero canonical QA touches on watch_guard were found (grepped before the move), so this is a silent relocation, unlike Selys's own heavily-repathed relocation. Zevara Sunderscale STAYS at the gate (zevara_intro's own framing untouched) -- the barracks holds only her DESK (zevara_desk, flavor/observe, she is rarely at it). THE CELL (cell_door) is empty-v1, dressed, a quest-outcome surface for later -- same locked-prop idiom as inn_upstairs's lyonette_door (flush against a wall, no interior room modeled behind it, no requires_skill so a plain interact reads the locked_toast). Reuses the 'inn' biome (Interior_Walls_01.png) like guild/inn_upstairs -- every interior in this game differentiates via moods.json's grade + dressing, not new tile assets; moods.json's 'barracks' card supplies the 'stern'/cool-institutional grade. Kit racks (shelf_bottles) + a briefing table (table_brown) + a kit crate (all ADDED to `blocked`, THE BLOCKING CONTRACT) + a stool (intentionally walkable, matching the guild/inn precedent) dress the room duty-mundane, per the canon note that the barracks is a SETTING, not a bounty source (watch-flavored bounties still post at the Guild board, per the ratified spec).

segments._comment: South wall, gapped at x=2 for barracks_exit.

entities._comment: Duty Sergeant Dresk Ashgrave -- the relocated watch_guard (see map comment above). talk_pool fires first-talk-of-the-waking as before; a REAL `conversation` (issue #81) now backs every talk after that instead of the old repeated-forever dialogue[0] fallback -- gated content only (the 'Ask about the missing recruit.' option requires the guild_board's rumor_missing_recruit having been read), so this fixture's own pre-#81 canonicals (barracks_walkthrough, archer_earn_loop) stay byte-identical: neither re-talks to Dresk a second time in one waking.
entities.observe: A belt-slate at his hip, chalk stub worn to a nub, already a line into today's tally. Rust-brown scales, no plate for a desk posting — he'd rather be finishing the count than talking to you.
talk_pool: Sergeant Ashgrave. If you're here to report something, the slate's on the wall. Write it plain.
Quiet shift. Kit's counted, slates are current, and the cell's empty. Write that down as a good day.
Barracks business, filed here. Yours is filed at the gate.

dialogue.speaker: Dresk
dialogue.text: Barracks is Watch business only. State yours.

entities._comment: Zevara's desk -- she stays at the gate (zevara_intro unchanged); this is flavor/observe only, the barracks holding her paperwork rather than her person.
entities.observe: Tidier than her schedule allows. A stack of gate-shift reports pinned under a paperweight shaped vaguely like a threat. She is almost never behind it. The gate keeps her busier than her own office does.
entities.toast: Watch Captain's desk. Empty, same as every other time you've walked past it.

entities._comment: THE CELL, empty v1 and dressed -- a quest-outcome surface for later. Flush against the east wall, same idiom as inn_upstairs's lyonette_door (a locked prop, not a real door -- no room modeled behind it). No requires_skill, so a plain interact reads the locked_toast (the sewer_debris/lyonette_door seam).
entities.locked_toast: Barred, and empty behind the bars. You can tell by the quiet. Whatever ends up in here hasn't happened yet.
entities.observe: A single holding cell, iron-barred, straw swept into one corner. Duty-mundane, like everything else in this building — until it isn't.

entities._comment: GH#70 [Archer]'s earn seam: the practice archery butt, item-gated on carrying any bow (`requires_weapon_family`, wi_game.gd's interact() gate -- the small parallel to the #59 conversation item-gate for a bare prop, checked against the CARRIED inventory, not the equipped slot). Each successful interact banks `ranged_hit` DIRECTLY (the SAME counter a bow's basic Attack tallies in a real fight -- see wi_combat.gd's _resolve_hit doc comment) -- repeatable (nothing marks it consumed), so 3 practice shots alone clear [Archer]'s gained_by threshold with zero combat required, matching the classless-start onboarding parity every other earned class already gives (warrior=spar, mage/rogue/diplomat=one conversation). Reuses the `training_dummy` sprite (relc_spar's own straw-target art on a DIFFERENT map -- floodplains training_yard's Relc-run dummies vs this barracks butt, never on screen together) tinted straw-tan so it reads as a fixed range target rather than a hackable melee dummy. Placed at (11,1) against the north wall (the established 'against a wall' placement rule), approached from (11,2) -- reachable via the SAME (2,3)->(11,3) waypoints barracks_walkthrough's own cell_door leg already uses, then straight up 2, clear of every blocked/decor cell in the room (table_brown/shelf_bottles/crate all sit on row y=2 at x=3/6/9, never touched by this column-11 approach).
entities.observe: A straw-packed target lashed to a post, set against the wall where a stray shot won't find a person. Scored through in a tight cluster, more or less -- somebody here takes the drills seriously.
entities.item_hint_toast: Nothing to shoot with. A bow in hand would do it.
entities.toast: You put an arrow in the straw. Not bad, for someone who still flinches at the draw.

entities._comment: Issue #81 (exploration & optional content): a discovery prop that pays REAL (the gap-analysis finding -- 'exploration pays nothing'). Container shape (`contains`), the inn_chest/ruin_stones/anchor_stone_pedestal precedent -- grants `field_whetstone` via pickup() (its own 'Got: Field Whetstone' toast + ITEM_GAINED), which is ALREADY a purchasable Krshia item (data/dialogue/krshia_crate.json) whose own lore ('half the Watch loses theirs by spring') this find pays off directly -- zero new item catalog entry needed. Placed at (4,6), row y=6 -- confirmed UNWALKED by either barracks canonical (barracks_walkthrough/archer_earn_loop both stay within rows y=2-5 plus the x=2 exit column; row y=6 is untouched floor, no blocked cell, no decor). Sprite `crate` tinted worn-leather-brown, distinct from the room's own undertinted kit crate at (3,2) (decor, non-interactive).
entities.observe: A second kit crate, shoved into the corner and never reshelved. The sergeant's own tally probably missed it.

entities._comment: Issue #81 lore-note collectible thread: found-note item (kind:parcel, data/items.json), container shape identical to spare_kit_crate above (same row, same UNWALKED-cell proof). `on_open_accomplishment` is pure flavor -- nothing gates on it.
entities.observe: A folded half-letter, tucked behind a loose board. Someone started writing it and never finished.

entities._comment: Issue #81 lore-note collectible thread: RELOCATED here from the guild (its first home) after the scene_dynamism tool's own family-spread signal flagged the guild map -- two new props sharing props/free_pack there net-diluted composite (64.66 -> 64.51 pre-edit vs. post, measured, a real STOP-trigger regression per this task's own brief) with no thematically-honest non-free_pack alternative available; a THIRD barracks prop re-measured net POSITIVE for both maps (barracks 65.38 -> 65.75, guild recovers to 64.89) since barracks had more density headroom. Container shape identical to spare_kit_crate/note_watch_veteran above (same row, same UNWALKED-cell proof -- (11,6) is a third distinct cell on the row neither barracks canonical ever treads).
entities.observe: A scrap of paper pinned low, tucked behind a loose board same as the letter across the room.
